_about: Ways to earn with a skill while studying. Shown as ideas for people on a tight budget, never as job offers. Earnings depend on the person and market, so no amounts are given. caution notes legal or licensing limits.

excel: Spreadsheet clean-up and simple reports for small shops and home businesses
bookkeeping: Monthly bookkeeping for small businesses and home sellers
dataentry: Short data-entry jobs on freelance marketplaces (check the client and the pay before you start)
correspondence: Writing letters, product descriptions or minutes for small businesses
content: Writing product descriptions, blog posts or captions for online sellers
languages: Translation and interpreting for local businesses and community groups
customer: Part-time customer chat support for online sellers
digimarketing: Managing social media pages for local small businesses
design: Designing posters and social-media graphics with free tools
helpdesk: Setting up laptops, phones and Wi-Fi for neighbours and small offices
python: Small automation scripts for small businesses
dataviz: Simple sales dashboards for small businesses
sql: Fixing and querying small business databases
genai: Helping small businesses set up AI tools for everyday tasks
coaching: Tutoring school students in subjects you know well
fieldwork: Part-time survey or research assistant work
esg: Helping small companies collect data for a basic sustainability report
electrical: Helper to a licensed electrical contractor
solar: Helper to a registered solar installer

caution.electrical: Only competent persons certified by the Energy Commission may carry out electrical wiring work in Malaysia. Work as a helper under a licensed contractor.
caution.solar: Installation must follow the registered installer's supervision and safety rules.
